column1: # `overworld.md §8.1`, the falls chain. Standing directly north of a
# waterfall tile, any turn-consuming command runs it: `F-A-L-L-S!!!`,
# two forced steps south, the descending sweep, the hidden party
# marker, and - only when the landing cell is Britannia `(54, 138)` -
# `Falling into underworld!!`. Both lines are on the coverage backlog,
# and this is the one waterfall of the three on the map whose landing
# cell gates the second one.
# Seeded with `seed_position <profile> plane=britannia x=54 y=136`;
# `find_tile` reads `(54, 137)` as the waterfall and `(54, 136)` as the
# cell above it.
# The roster panel is a roster lottery here. Each fall checks the Avatar
# once (`overworld.md §8`, the shared skewed `1..30` roll against Dexterity
# 30), and since playtest Q11 the damage helper repaints the panel at once
# (`§6.2.4`), so a hit shows as `59G` from the first beat on. Measured
# 2026-10-25 on rc12: the engine drew the hit in 20261025-045722, the
# stock side drew it in 20261025-080315 (and repainted on the spot, which
# confirms Q11), and 20261025-073049 matched with neither. The message
# window is fixed text and still decides the verdict; the repaint itself is
# pinned deterministically by `overworld-falls-damage`.
# requires-seed: the party on Britannia directly north of the falls
